notes.title: Restocker Employee Update
notes.content:
Restocker Employee

- Add arrangement workers
- You can now hire workers to help you organize the store.
- They arrange according to the picture on each shelf. They carry the boxes from the shelves in the 
   warehouse and then fill them in the store shelves according to the picture on each shelf.


Item image on each shelf

- Now you can order the item by just clicking on the item's image on the shelf and it will be automatically 
  added to the cart on your computer to order it.
- You can also delete the image on the shelf.


Customers at night
- Now there is a percentage of customers who can buy at night


Night mode

- Improve the night in the game to become more realistic than before


[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1217093808102178907/1260673609056124969/bb.jpg?ex=66902d4a&is=668edbca&hm=a3188acef9e63f9495b433a6cddef9d12749170e4a648adf4db5e2049f4dec38&[/img]

tags.feature: - Add arrangement workers
- You can now hire workers to help you organize the store.

- They arrange according to the picture on each shelf. They carry the boxes from the shelves in the 
   warehouse and then fill them in the store shelves according to the picture on each shelf.

- Now you can order the item by just clicking on the item's image on the shelf and it will be automatically 
  added to the cart on your computer to order it.
- You can also delete the image on the shelf.
- Now there is a percentage of customers who can buy at night
- Improve the night in the game to become more realistic than before

notes.title: Day Night Update
notes.content:
- There is now a day and night system in the game.
- You will only be able to sell a little at night because people prefer to buy during the day.
- Fix some words in many languages
- Fixed some problems that rarely appeared, such as not responding when changing the store name or 
   exterior color.
- Improve the code and reduce the game's usage of device resources.


[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1217093808102178907/1259555666121457704/DayNightUpdate.jpg?ex=668c1c20&is=668acaa0&hm=65f1fb6de93d1d97a1b521b1bbfe7abbe1b6e002ae8ac0ec30cb9415e3198f9f&=&format=webp&width=1177&height=662[/img]
